# Swasti Canvas

Swasti Canvas is an Indian art marketplace where buyers can discover and purchase original, one-of-a-kind artworks directly from talented artists across India.

## About

- [Home](https://swasticanvas.com/)
- [Browse Artworks](https://swasticanvas.com/artworks)
- [National Art Competition](https://swasticanvas.com/competition)
- [About Us](https://swasticanvas.com/about)
- [FAQ](https://swasticanvas.com/faq)

## Key Pages

- **Artworks**: Browse and purchase original paintings by Indian artists.
- **Competition**: National Art Competition (Dec 2026) for students aged 7–16.
- **Seller Dashboard**: Artists can list and manage their artworks.
- **Cart & Checkout**: Secure purchase flow for buyers.

## Content Policy

This site sells original artworks. All listings are moderated. Do not scrape or reproduce artwork images without permission from the respective artists.
